hardware: Ryzen 9 9950X / RTX 5090 / 128 GiB RAM, Windows, MSVC 19.44, CUDA 13.0.48
method: 2 GiB rotating source; fixed pinned destination; separate CPU, CUDA-event H2D, serial copy+H2D measurements. Six rounds ABBAAB. Offset is relative to vector data, not a claim of 64-byte base alignment. Final GPU bytes checked in every row. This is not model throughput.
decision: Production retains std::memcpy; NT regressions at 1 MiB and no consistent larger-block gain.
